Table 7
Comparison of capacity retention after 200 cycles at 0.5C for LLTO coated NCM.
Columns: Coating material | Capacity retention | Comparison with pristine NCM
Coating material | Capacity retention | Comparison with pristine NCM
LLTO-0.5 | 85.5% | Higher
LLTO-1 | 86.2% | Higher
LLTO-2 | 57.2% | Lower

The LLTO-1 coating retained the most capacity after 200 cycles at 0.5C. It compared higher with the pristine NCM. The 2 mol.% coating (LLTO-2) lowered the rate capability, which may be due to the increase in the thickness of the coating layer, resulting in the suppression of electron transfer process during charge/discharge cycling.
